finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The 'expression' parameter is attacker-controlled and can be crafted to include shell metacharacters.

parsed.refutation_attempt: I examined the call sites (lines 67‑71) and the implementation of is_balanced. The only sink is printf with a constant format string "%d\n", so the argument is an integer result, not a command string. The function is_balanced only manipulates a stack and never invokes system‑related APIs. No path exists from the user‑controlled expression to any function that could execute shell commands. Therefore the claim of OS Command Injection is unfounded.
